title: Test plan · Week 2 · v1
sub: 3 tests, $182 test budget for the week
headline: Plan keeps daily monitoring for test_1 at 71.3% of target with 23 results (ev-d14-test_1-readout), refreshes ad_3 at 24.60 over 3 days (ev-d8-ad_3-cpr3), and adds one true explore so the week is not only fixes.

content.summary: Plan keeps daily monitoring for test_1 at 71.3% of target with 23 results (ev-d14-test_1-readout), refreshes ad_3 at 24.60 over 3 days (ev-d8-ad_3-cpr3), and adds one true explore so the week is not only fixes.

tests.name: Harness Comfort-Control Continue
tests.hypothesis: If we build on test_1 walk-test learning at 11.41 per purchase with 23 results (ev-d14-test_1-readout), a comfort-first control angle will hold cost below 16 while we wait for 30 results to scale.
tests.stop_rule: Pause if cost_per_result > 16.00 after 1.5x target spend or 15 results; continue to 30 results if at or below target.

brief.hook: Steer gently, stroll happy — soft on fur, easy on you
brief.key_message: Front-clip steering plus soft padding makes walks feel calm and controlled for the no-pull dog harness.

tests.name: Bundle Refresh - Free Shipping Helper
tests.hypothesis: If we replace the expensive bundle creative at 24.60 per purchase over 3 days (ev-d8-ad_3-cpr3) with a single-product free-shipping nudge, cost will move back toward 16.
tests.stop_rule: Stop if 3-day cost_per_result > 16.00 after 2x target spend; keep if at or below 16.00 through 25 results.

brief.key_message: Add the ceramic cat water fountain to your harness order to hit free shipping over $50 with one tidy product photo.

tests.name: Harness Style Explore v2
tests.hypothesis: If we try a style-led look for the proven harness winner at 12.97 per purchase (ev-w2-ad_1-week), we will learn whether color and style can keep cost below 16 in retargeting.
tests.stop_rule: Stop if cost_per_result > 16.00 after 2x target spend; iterate if cost stays at or below 16.00 after 20 results.

brief.hook: Pick your pop of color — walk out in style
brief.key_message: The same no-pull dog harness in fun solid colors and patterns that looks good on every walk.

evidence.note: Bundle – Free shipping over $50 (ad_3): last 3 days, days 6-8.
Harness – Studio carousel (ad_1): totals for week 2.
